# DevKDP — Free Developer Tools

> JSON formatter, Base64 encoder, and developer utilities. Real-time validation, no signup, runs in your browser.

## Tools

- [JSON Formatter](https://dev.kdp.cool/json-formatter/): real-time format, minify, and validate JSON with line-error parsing, depth and key-count stats.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://dev.kdp.cool/base64-encoder/): UTF-8 safe encoding, file upload (FileReader), URL-safe variant toggle.
